video_tutorials.title: Roborock first-time setup in 90 seconds
video_tutorials.transcript_summary: Plug dock against a flat wall with 1m clearance each side. Open Roborock app, scan QR on robot, follow pairing wizard. First map takes 25 minutes — let it finish before starting any clean.

video_tutorials.title: Why your Roborock keeps getting stuck — top 7 fixes
video_tutorials.transcript_summary: Cable spaghetti under desks, dark/high-pile rugs (cliff sensor false-positive), 1.5cm threshold strips, chair legs in the under-3cm zone, sock pickup, dust bin full, mop pad too wet on transitions. Fix each in turn.

video_tutorials.title: Replacing your filter, brush, and mop pads
video_tutorials.transcript_summary: Filter every 60-90 days (30-45 with pets). Main brush every 6-12 months. Side brushes every 3-6 months. Mop pads every ~50 washes or when fraying. The 6-month replenish kit covers all of it on schedule.

video_tutorials.title: Setting up no-go zones and virtual walls in the app
video_tutorials.transcript_summary: Open the map in the Roborock app, tap Edit Map, drag rectangles for no-go zones (around pet bowls or fragile vases), or draw lines for virtual walls (across doorways for off-limits rooms). Saves per-floor.

video_tutorials.title: When to deep-clean the dock vs. the robot itself
video_tutorials.transcript_summary: Dock: empty waste-water tank weekly, refill clean-water tank weekly, scrub the auto-wash basin monthly. Robot: rinse the dustbin filter monthly under cold water, dry 24h before reinstalling.

parts_finder.fitment_note: Fits all S-Series Pro generations (2024+). Snap-out replacement, no tools. Includes 2 HEPA filters, 1 main brush, 2 side brushes, 4 mop pads.
Same Replenish Kit fits both S-Series Pro and E-Series Essential. The mop pads in the kit are unused on the E-Series (no wet-mop module) — keep as spares or recycle.
